purpose: Teach: 恐ろしく/耐える/説い/ただちに/従わ/免れ/我ら/ですけれど

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが恐ろしく頑固な時もあった
lines.en: You know, when your father was younger, he could be terribly stubborn sometimes.
lines.style: Gentle, searching tone. Soft opening. A memory surfacing slowly, with affection underneath. Pause before continuing — not filling silence.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、苦難に耐える強さをお持ちだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and he had such strength to bear hardship, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, affirming. A gentle correction, not lecturing. She's completing his thought with her own memory. Steady, tender confidence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが孫に人の道を説いて下さった
lines.en: When he was younger, your father would teach his grandchildren the way of things.
lines.style: Reflective, reverent. The words come with quiet weight. Pause between phrases — each memory distinct and carefully held.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、緊急時にはただちに動かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And when there was urgent need, he would act without hesitation, wouldn't he, dear?
lines.style: Admiring, matter-of-fact. Not dramatic — stating what she knows to be true. The respect in her voice is quiet and certain.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが理に従わない方を諭された
lines.en: When he was young, your father would gently guide those who strayed from reason.
lines.style: Thoughtful, gentle. The words deliberate. A slight tremor of old grief under the surface, carefully contained.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、戦地で死を免れた英雄だったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He was a hero who escaped death in the war, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Solemn, grateful. Deep breath before speaking. The words carry the weight of decades of relief and gratitude. Steady voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、「我らは一族」とお父さんが仰った
lines.en: When he was younger, your father used to say, 'We are one family.'
lines.style: Quiet, almost reverential. Each word distinct. A gentle smile in the voice. The phrase lingers — he's remembering the exact sound of his father's voice.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、寡黙ですけれど深い愛情の方だったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He was quiet, but such a man of deep love, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Tender, final. Her voice soft and sure. Not a question really — a confirmation, a benediction. The natural close of a memory held together across decades.
